issue_context.title: Crashing when entering (sometimes) my Images folder
issue_context.body:
### Description

Sometimes if I enter my Images folder it will crash with the "something went wrong" notification and this on the debug.log:

> 2021-10-13 21:09:01.8454|ERROR|AppUnhandledException|Object reference not set to an instance of an object.
> 	System.NullReferenceException: Object reference not set to an instance of an object.
>    at Files.Views.LayoutModes.GridViewBrowser.GridViewBrowser_obj27_Bindings.Update_LoadFileIcon(Boolean, Int32) + 0x43
>    at Files.Views.LayoutModes.GridViewBrowser.GridViewBrowser_obj27_Bindings.GridViewBrowser_obj27_BindingsTracking.PropertyChanged_(Object, PropertyChangedEventArgs) + 0x469
>    at System.Action`2.InvokeMulticastThunk(T1, T2) + 0x4e
>    at System.EventHandler`1.Invoke(Object, TEventArgs) + 0x2e
>    at Microsoft.Toolkit.Mvvm.ComponentModel.ObservableObject.SetProperty[T](T&, T, String) + 0x9c
>    at Files.Filesystem.ListedItem.Img_ImageOpened(Object, RoutedEventArgs) + 0x55
>    at Microsoft.Toolkit.Uwp.UI.Controls.InAppNotificationOpeningEventHandler.Invoke(Object, InAppNotificationOpeningEventArgs) + 0x2e
>    at __Interop.Intrinsics.HasThisCall__23[TArg0](Object, IntPtr, Object, TArg0) + 0x36
>    at Files!<BaseAddress>+0x12b1f30

debug_fulltrust.log:

> 2021-10-13 21:10:14.4828|WARN|ParseFileOperationAsync|Devuelto error HRESULT E_FAIL de una llamada a un componente COM.
> 	System.Runtime.InteropServices.COMException (0x80004005): Devuelto error HRESULT E_FAIL de una llamada a un componente COM.
>    en Vanara.PInvoke.Shell32.IShellLinkW.Resolve(HWND hwnd, SLR_FLAGS fFlags)
>    en Vanara.Windows.Shell.ShellLink.LoadAndResolve(String linkFile, SLR_FLAGS resolveFlags, HWND hWin, UInt16 timeOut)
>    en FilesFullTrust.MessageHandlers.FileOperationsHandler.<ParseFileOperationAsync>d__4.MoveNext()
> 2021-10-13 21:10:14.5378|INFO|Connection_RequestReceived|Argument: FileOperation
> 2021-10-13 21:10:14.5488|WARN|ParseFileOperationAsync|El sistema no puede encontrar el archivo especificado. (Excepción de HRESULT: 0x80070002)
> 	System.IO.FileNotFoundException: El sistema no puede encontrar el archivo especificado. (Excepción de HRESULT: 0x80070002)
>    en Vanara.PInvoke.Shell32.ShellUtil.GetShellItemForPath(String path)
>    en Vanara.Windows.Shell.ShellLink.get_Target()
>    en FilesFullTrust.MessageHandlers.FileOperationsHandler.<ParseFileOperationAsync>d__4.MoveNext()

On the end of the post I will add the full logs, tough there is nothing else relevant I think.


### Steps To Reproduce

1. Go to a folder that has a lot of content (I guess... my Images folder has 3552 items)
2. If it's not crashing, open a new tab and try again.

It's not crashing all the times, but eventually it will crash (more or less at the third time, but I got this on the first time I opened Images folder after installing last version), at least in my testings.

### Expected behavior

Should not crash

### Files Version

V2.0.19.0

### Windows Version

Windows 10 21H1 10.0.19043.1288

### Relevant Assets

[debug.log](https://github.com/files-community/Files/files/7340743/debug.log)
[debug_fulltrust.log](https://github.com/files-community/Files/files/7340744/debug_fulltrust.log)

In my testings:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11770760/137198681-db450c0d-809d-40f7-ab93-ac8883e98f6f.png)
comments: Could you check if it still does that if you turn off the "enable individual preferences for folders" option? (check the various layout modes if you can)

> Could you check if it still does that if you turn off the "enable individual preferences for folders" option? (check the various layout modes if you can)

Tested all layout modes and they aren't crashing with that option disabled. Files will hang and become unresponsive sometimes, but after a little time it will be responsive and in any case it's not crashing.
I think it gets angry when layout mode is switched during image load, e.g when the adaptive layout kicks in?

> I think it gets angry when layout mode is switched during image load, e.g when the adaptive layout kicks in?

I can't replicate today so I can't say for sure but IIRC it wasn't on the layout mode change, but just when entering the folder, before it got all the items loaded it hanged.

I will still test it to check if I can replicate again the unresponsiveness (I've tried opening several times and switching the layout while loading but today is working as expected).
This issue should be resolved with #6674.
